notes: First-party plugins (tier=first-party in plugin-marketplace-curated.json) are marked installed+enabled before Plugin OS bootstrap so loadEligible is true.
Set autoEnableFirstParty to false or ZAVORTH_PLUGIN_OS_BOOTSTRAP=0 to disable.
respectUserDisable skips plugins the user explicitly disabled in .zavorth/plugin-os-state.json.
Examples stay opt-in unless autoEnableExamples is true.
